agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
December 4, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval  for  November  6,  2024,  Planning  Commission
  meeting(s).

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. To grant a General Plan Amendment No. 2022-001 (GPA-2022-001)
  to amend the Land Use Element Map of the Inglewood General Plan
  from Industrial to Commercial/Residential associated with a
  request to develop an approximately 333,500 square-foot, 13-
  story mixed-use building that will include 11 residential
  condominium units, a 293-room hotel, and retail uses. The
  subject site is located on an approximately 1.98-acre C-2A
  (Airport Commercial) zoned property at 4200 West Century
  Boulevard and legally described as the Extension of Streets of
  Lots 571 and 572 and east 23.53 feet of the Extension of Streets
  of Lot 573 of Tract no. 211(AINs: 4034-002-001; 002; 004).

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to RECOMMEND the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-MND-2022-113;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving GPA-2022-001.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A continued public hearing to consider an application by So-In-
  To-It, LLC for a Special Use Permit No. 24-00019 (SUP24-00019)
  to amend certain conditions of approval to SP-2020-004 for an
  existing three-story hotel and restaurant on an approximately
  86,102 square-foot, M-1L (Limited Manufacturing) zoned property
  at 3900 West Century Boulevard.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-126;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP24-00019.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents
   c. A continued public hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment
  No. 24-00002 (ZCA24-00002) to establish Inclusionary Zoning
  Regulations to Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to RECOMMEND the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-115;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving ZCA24-00002.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  Item 6c Documents

  d. A public hearing to consider an application by Christian Martin,
  representing 3 Van Ness Ave Corp., for Special Use Permit No.
  24-00028 (SUP24-00028) to allow the sale of distilled spirits
  for on-site consumption and outdoor dining for an existing
  restaurant on an approximately 4,992 square-foot C-2 (General
  Commercial) zoned property at 7927 South Van Ness Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-136;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP24-00028.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C.If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6d Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of December 4, 2024
is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda
item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda
item will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning
Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 5, 2025, 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
